tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsol 'debs dpal ldan rgyal ba thams cad ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /brgyud pa kun 'dus nor bu rin po che/ /mtshan tsam dran pas 'dod dgu'i dpal stsol ba/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa bdag la thugs rje gzigs/ /gzigs shig gzigs shig da lta byin gyis rlobs/ /chos med bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ / bla ma khyed dang 'bral ba med pa dang*/ /rje btsun khyed kyi go 'phang thob par shog /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams rtogs rnams bskyed du gsol/ /byin rlabs rnams stsal du gsol/ /dbang mchog rnams bskur du gsol/ /dal 'byor mi lus rnyed pa'i brgya lam na/ / dam pa'i chos dang mjal ba res 'ga' tsam/ /mi tshe stong par zad pa'i snying med po/ /nyams len byed snyam ngang la 'das pa na/ /gzigs shig gzigs shig da lta byin gyis rlobs/ /chos med bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ / bla ma khyed dang 'bral ba med pa dang*/ /rje btsun khyod kyi go 'phang thob par shog /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams rtogs rnams bskyed du gsol/ /byin rlabs rnams stsal du gsol/ /dbang mchog rnams bskur du gsol/ /'gyu ba'i dbugs kyang chad la nye ba dang*/ / kham gcig zos pa'ang dang gar mi 'ong zhing*/ /rang gis rang la yid chad byed pa dang*/ /grogs dang gnyen la re thag chad pa'i dus/ /gzigs shig gzigs shig da lta byin gyis rlobs/ /chos med bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ / bla ma khyed dang 'bral ba med pa dang*/ /rje btsun khyod kyi go 'phang thob par shog /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams rtogs rnams bskyed du gsol/ /byin rlabs rnams stsal du gsol/ /dbang mchog rnams bskur du gsol/ /gshin rje'i skyes bus dbang med bcings nas khrid/ /dmyal ba'i me tshogs 'bar ba'i nang du lhung*/ /'jigs rung mtshon cha'i char pa lus la phog

/las ngan dbang gis tshe la 'khyol du med/ /gzigs shig gzigs shig da lta byin gyis rlobs/ /chos med bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /bla ma khyed dang 'bral ba med pa dang*/ /rje btsun khyod kyi go 'phang thob par shog /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ / nyams rtogs rnams bskyed du gsol/ /byin rlabs rnams stsal du gsol/ / dbang mchog rnams bskur du gsol/ /grang bas nyen nas brgya tshal stong tshal du/ /gas pa'i dus na mgon skyabs gzhan ma mchis/ /lo brgya'i bar du zas skom kham gcig kyang*/ /ma rnyed bkres skom 'jigs pas nyen pa'i dus/ / gzigs shig gzigs shig da lta byin gyis rlobs/ /chos med bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /bla ma khyed dang 'bral ba med pa dang*/ /rje btsun khyod kyi go 'phang thob par shog /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams rtogs rnams bskyed du gsol/ /byin rlabs rnams stsal du gsol/ /dbang mchog rnams bskur du gsol/ /gcig la gcig za srog gcod bkol dang brdeg /skye rga na 'chi'i 'phrang ni nyams re nga*/ /mtho dman 'byor rgud mi rtag yi re 'byung*/ /'gro ba drug gi sems can snying re rje/ / gzigs shig gzigs shig da lta byin gyis brlobs/ /chos med bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /bla ma khyed dang 'bral ba med pa dang*/ /rje btsun khyod kyi go 'phang thob par shog /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams rtogs rnams bskyed du gsol/ /byin rlabs rnams stsal du gsol/ /dbang mchog rnams bskur du gsol/ /ngur smrig gyon yang shes rgyud rtsub cing gyong*/ /dge sbyor kun yang tshe 'di'i che khar song*/ /chos skad 'grig 'grig smra yang sems ma thul/ kha dang lag len 'gal ba'i zog po la/ /gzigs shig gzigs shig da lta byin gyis rlobs/ /pha bla ma'i sku yis byin gyis rlobs/

/pha bla ma'i gsung gis byin gyis rlobs/ /pha bla ma'i thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /sprang chos med po la gzigs shig da lta byin gyis rlobs/ /chos med bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /bla ma khyed dang 'bral ba med pa dang*/ /rje btsun khyod kyi go 'phang thob par shog /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams rtogs rnams bskyed du gsol/ /byin rlabs rnams stsal du gsol/ /dbang mchog rnams bskur du gsol/ / zhes pa 'di yang skyor mo lung pa dar rgyas dpal 'byor gyis bskul nas tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 10 -- PAGE 11 -- PAGE 9 -
